<script>
(function() {
  'use strict';

  const captionClass = 'exif-caption';
  const captionId = 'exif-caption-overlay';
  const exifCache = new WeakMap();

  function ensureCaptionStyle() {
    if (document.getElementById('exif-caption-style')) return;
    const style = document.createElement('style');
    style.id = 'exif-caption-style';
    style.textContent = `
      .${captionClass} {
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 1001;
        padding: 6px 10px;
        border-radius: 6px;
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.4;
        color: #fff;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65);
        max-width: 90vw;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        pointer-events: none;
        text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      }
      .exif-caption-inline {
        margin-top: 6px;
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.4;
        color: var(--text-color, #666);
        text-align: left;
        word-break: break-word;
      }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
  }

  function formatExposure(value) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) return '';
    if (typeof value === 'string') return value.includes('/') ? `${value}s` : value;
    if (typeof value === 'number') {
      if (value >= 1) return `${value}s`;
      const denom = Math.round(1 / value);
      return `1/${denom}s`;
    }
    return '';
  }

  function formatFNumber(value) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) return '';
    if (typeof value === 'string') return value.toLowerCase().startsWith('f') ? value : `f/${value}`;
    if (typeof value === 'number') return `f/${value}`;
    return '';
  }

  function formatFocalLength(value) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) return '';
    if (typeof value === 'string') return value.includes('mm') ? value : `${value}mm`;
    if (typeof value === 'number') return `${value}mm`;
    return '';
  }

  function normalizeTags(tags) {
    const make = tags.Make || '';
    const model = tags.Model || '';
    const lens = tags.LensModel || tags.LensMake || '';
    const exposure = formatExposure(tags.ExposureTime);
    const fNumber = formatFNumber(tags.FNumber || tags.ApertureValue);
    const iso = tags.ISOSpeedRatings || tags.ISO || '';
    const focal = formatFocalLength(tags.FocalLength);
    const date = tags.DateTimeOriginal || tags.DateTime || '';

    const parts = [];
    const camera = `${make} ${model}`.trim();
    if (camera) parts.push(camera);
    if (lens) parts.push(lens);
    const settings = [exposure, fNumber, iso ? `ISO ${iso}` : '', focal].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
    if (settings) parts.push(settings);
    if (date) parts.push(date);
    return parts.length ? parts.join(' / ') : '无 EXIF 信息';
  }

  function getExifText(img, callback) {
    if (exifCache.has(img)) {
      callback(exifCache.get(img));
      return;
    }
    if (!window.EXIF) {
      callback('EXIF 库未加载');
      return;
    }
    const run = function() {
      window.EXIF.getData(img, function() {
        const tags = window.EXIF.getAllTags(this) || {};
        const text = normalizeTags(tags);
        exifCache.set(img, text);
        callback(text);
      });
    };
    if (img.complete) run();
    else img.addEventListener('load', run, { once: true });
  }

  function removeCaption() {
    const caption = document.getElementById(captionId);
    if (caption) caption.remove();
  }

  function placeCaption(text, target) {
    removeCaption();
    if (!target) return;
    ensureCaptionStyle();
    const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
    const caption = document.createElement('div');
    caption.id = captionId;
    caption.className = captionClass;
    caption.textContent = text;
    caption.style.left = `${Math.max(12, rect.left + window.scrollX)}px`;
    caption.style.top = `${rect.bottom + window.scrollY + 8}px`;
    caption.style.maxWidth = `${Math.min(rect.width, window.innerWidth - 24)}px`;
    document.body.appendChild(caption);
  }

  function setInlineCaption(img, text) {
    if (!img || img.dataset.exifInlineDone) return;
    img.dataset.exifInlineDone = 'true';
    const figure = img.closest('figure');
    if (figure) {
      let figcaption = figure.querySelector('figcaption');
      if (!figcaption) {
        figcaption = document.createElement('figcaption');
        figure.appendChild(figcaption);
      }
      figcaption.classList.add('exif-caption-inline');
      figcaption.textContent = text;
      return;
    }
    const caption = document.createElement('div');
    caption.className = 'exif-caption-inline';
    caption.textContent = text;
    img.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', caption);
  }

  function findOpenedZoomImage() {
    return document.querySelector('.medium-zoom-image--opened');
  }

  function initExifCaption() {
    const inlineImages = document.querySelectorAll('.post-body img');
    inlineImages.forEach(function(img) {
      getExifText(img, function(text) {
        if (!text || text === '无 EXIF 信息') return;
        setInlineCaption(img, text);
      });
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
      const img = event.target.closest('.post-body img');
      if (!img) return;

      setTimeout(function() {
        const zoomed = findOpenedZoomImage();
        if (!zoomed) return;
        getExifText(img, function(text) {
          placeCaption(text, zoomed);
        });
      }, 80);
    });

    document.addEventListener('keyup', function(event) {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') removeCaption();
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
      if (!event.target || !event.target.classList) return;
      if (event.target.classList.contains('medium-zoom-overlay') ||
          event.target.classList.contains('medium-zoom-image--opened')) {
        removeCaption();
      }
    });

    const observer = new MutationObserver(function() {
      if (!findOpenedZoomImage()) removeCaption();
    });
    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initExifCaption);
  } else {
    initExifCaption();
  }
})();
</script>

      }
      .banner-prev { left: 20px; }
      .banner-next { right: 20px; }
      .banner-dots {
        position: absolute;
        left: 50%;
        bottom: 15px;
        transform: translateX(-50%);
        display: flex;
        gap: 8px;
        z-index: 20;
      }
      .banner-dot {
        width: 8px;
        height: 8px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
      }
      .banner-dot.active {
        background: #fff;
        transform: scale(1.2);
        box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      }
      
      @media (max-width: 768px) {
        .banner-carousel {
          height: clamp(220px, 70vw, 360px);
        }
        .banner-slide {
          flex: 0 0 85%;
          margin: 0 6px;
        }
        .banner-prev, .banner-next {
          width: 32px;
          height: 32px;
          font-size: 18px;
        }
      }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
  }

  function initCarousel(carousel) {
    const track = carousel.querySelector('.banner-track');
    const slides = Array.from(carousel.querySelectorAll('.banner-slide'));
    let prevBtn = carousel.querySelector('.banner-prev');
    let nextBtn = carousel.querySelector('.banner-next');
    let dotsWrap = carousel.querySelector('.banner-dots');
    const autoplay = Number(carousel.dataset.autoplay || 0);
    let index = 0;
    let timer = null;

    if (!track || slides.length === 0) return;

    if (!prevBtn) {
      prevBtn = document.createElement('button');
      prevBtn.type = 'button';
      prevBtn.className = 'banner-prev';
      prevBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Previous slide');
      prevBtn.innerHTML = '‹';
      carousel.appendChild(prevBtn);
    }

    if (!nextBtn) {
      nextBtn = document.createElement('button');
      nextBtn.type = 'button';
      nextBtn.className = 'banner-next';
      nextBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Next slide');
      nextBtn.innerHTML = '›';
      carousel.appendChild(nextBtn);
    }

    if (!dotsWrap) {
      dotsWrap = document.createElement('div');
      dotsWrap.className = 'banner-dots';
      carousel.appendChild(dotsWrap);
    }

    dotsWrap.innerHTML = '';
    const dots = slides.map(function(_, i) {
      const dot = document.createElement('span');
      dot.className = 'banner-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
      dot.addEventListener('click', function() {
        goTo(i);
      });
      dotsWrap.appendChild(dot);
      return dot;
    });

    slides.forEach(function(slide, i) {
      slide.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (index !== i) goTo(i);
      });
    });

    function update() {
      const containerWidth = carousel.offsetWidth;
      const slide = slides[0];
      const style = window.getComputedStyle(slide);
      const slideWidth = slide.offsetWidth;
      const margin = parseFloat(style.marginLeft) + parseFloat(style.marginRight);
      const fullSlideWidth = slideWidth + margin;
      const prevIndex = (index - 1 + slides.length) % slides.length;
      const nextIndex = (index + 1) % slides.length;

      const trackShift = (containerWidth / 2) - ((index * fullSlideWidth) + (fullSlideWidth / 2));
      
      track.style.transform = `translateX(${trackShift}px)`;

      slides.forEach(function(s, i) {
        s.classList.toggle('active', i === index);
        s.classList.toggle('is-prev', i === prevIndex);
        s.classList.toggle('is-next', i === nextIndex);
      });
      dots.forEach(function(d, i) {
        d.classList.toggle('active', i === index);
      });
    }

    function goTo(i) {
      index = (i + slides.length) % slides.length;
      update();
    }

    function next() {
      goTo(index + 1);
    }

    function prev() {
      goTo(index - 1);
    }

    if (nextBtn) nextBtn.addEventListener('click', next);
    if (prevBtn) prevBtn.addEventListener('click', prev);

    window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
      requestAnimationFrame(update);
    });

    setTimeout(update, 50);

    if (autoplay > 0) {
      const start = function() {
        timer = setInterval(next, autoplay);
      };
      const stop = function() {
        if (timer) clearInterval(timer);
        timer = null;
      };
      carousel.addEventListener('mouseenter', stop);
      carousel.addEventListener('mouseleave', start);
      start();
    }
  }

  function initBannerCarousels() {
    ensureBannerStyle();
    document.querySelectorAll('.banner-carousel').forEach(initCarousel);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initBannerCarousels);
  } else {
    initBannerCarousels();
  }
})();
</script>

  'use strict';
  
  // 添加暗黑模式切换按钮的CSS

    }
    
    /* NexT 变量驱动的暗黑/明亮模式覆盖（手动切换优先于系统） */

  // 注入CSS
  const style = document.createElement('style');
  style.textContent = darkModeCSS;
  document.head.appendChild(style);
  
  // 检测系统主题偏好
  function getSystemTheme() {
    return window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
  }
  
  // 获取用户主题偏好（兼容旧键名）
  function getUserTheme() {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('color-scheme') || localStorage.getItem('dark-mode');
    if (saved === 'dark' || saved === 'light') return saved === 'dark';
    if (saved !== null) return saved === 'true';
    return getSystemTheme(); // 默认跟随系统
  }
  
  // 应用主题（同步 html data-theme 与 body.dark，兼容自定义样式与 NexT 变量）
  function applyTheme(isDark) {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
    document.body.classList.toggle('dark', isDark);
  }
  
  // 创建切换按钮
  function createToggleButton() {
    const button = document.createElement('button');
    button.className = 'dark-mode-toggle';
    button.title = '切换暗黑模式';
    
    const icon = document.createElement('div');
    icon.className = 'toggle-icon';
    icon.innerHTML = '☀';
    button.appendChild(icon);
    
    // 初始化主题
    const isDark = getUserTheme();
    applyTheme(isDark);
    updateIcon(icon, isDark);
    
    // 点击事件
    button.addEventListener('click', function() {
      const currentlyDark = document.body.classList.contains('dark');
      const newDark = !currentlyDark;
      
      applyTheme(newDark);
      updateIcon(icon, newDark);
      
      // 保存到本地存储（兼容旧键）
      localStorage.setItem('color-scheme', newDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
      localStorage.setItem('dark-mode', newDark);
      
      // 平滑动画
      document.body.style.transition = 'background-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease';
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.body.style.transition = '';
      }, 300);
    });
    
    document.body.appendChild(button);
  }
  
  // 更新图标
  function updateIcon(icon, isDark) {
    if (isDark) {
      icon.innerHTML = '🌙';
    } else {
      icon.innerHTML = '☀';
    }
  }
  
  // 监听系统主题变化（仅在未手动设置时跟随）
  function watchSystemTheme() {
    if (!window.matchMedia) return;
    const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    const handler = function(e) {
      if (localStorage.getItem('color-scheme') === null && localStorage.getItem('dark-mode') === null) {
        const isDark = e.matches;
        const icon = document.querySelector('.toggle-icon');
        applyTheme(isDark);
        if (icon) updateIcon(icon, isDark);
      }
    };
    if (mediaQuery.addEventListener) mediaQuery.addEventListener('change', handler);
    else if (mediaQuery.addListener) mediaQuery.addListener(handler);
  }
  
  // 页面加载完成后创建按钮
  function init() {
    createToggleButton();
    watchSystemTheme();
  }
  
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
  
})();
</script>

<script>
(function() {
  'use strict';

  const captionClass = 'exif-caption';
  const captionId = 'exif-caption-overlay';
  const exifCache = new WeakMap();

  function ensureCaptionStyle() {
    if (document.getElementById('exif-caption-style')) return;
    const style = document.createElement('style');
    style.id = 'exif-caption-style';
    style.textContent = `
      .${captionClass} {
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 1001;
        padding: 6px 10px;
        border-radius: 6px;
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.4;
        color: #fff;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65);
        max-width: 90vw;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        pointer-events: none;
        text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      }
      .exif-caption-inline {
        margin-top: 6px;
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.4;
        color: var(--text-color, #666);
        text-align: left;
        word-break: break-word;
      }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
  }

  function formatExposure(value) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) return '';
    if (typeof value === 'string') return value.includes('/') ? `${value}s` : value;
    if (typeof value === 'number') {
      if (value >= 1) return `${value}s`;
      const denom = Math.round(1 / value);
      return `1/${denom}s`;
    }
    return '';
  }

  function formatFNumber(value) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) return '';
    if (typeof value === 'string') return value.toLowerCase().startsWith('f') ? value : `f/${value}`;
    if (typeof value === 'number') return `f/${value}`;
    return '';
  }

  function formatFocalLength(value) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) return '';
    if (typeof value === 'string') return value.includes('mm') ? value : `${value}mm`;
    if (typeof value === 'number') return `${value}mm`;
    return '';
  }

  function normalizeTags(tags) {
    const make = tags.Make || '';
    const model = tags.Model || '';
    const lens = tags.LensModel || tags.LensMake || '';
    const exposure = formatExposure(tags.ExposureTime);
    const fNumber = formatFNumber(tags.FNumber || tags.ApertureValue);
    const iso = tags.ISOSpeedRatings || tags.ISO || '';
    const focal = formatFocalLength(tags.FocalLength);
    const date = tags.DateTimeOriginal || tags.DateTime || '';

    const parts = [];
    const camera = `${make} ${model}`.trim();
    if (camera) parts.push(camera);
    if (lens) parts.push(lens);
    const settings = [exposure, fNumber, iso ? `ISO ${iso}` : '', focal].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
    if (settings) parts.push(settings);
    if (date) parts.push(date);
    return parts.length ? parts.join(' / ') : '无 EXIF 信息';
  }

  function getExifText(img, callback) {
    if (exifCache.has(img)) {
      callback(exifCache.get(img));
      return;
    }
    if (!window.EXIF) {
      callback('EXIF 库未加载');
      return;
    }
    const run = function() {
      window.EXIF.getData(img, function() {
        const tags = window.EXIF.getAllTags(this) || {};
        const text = normalizeTags(tags);
        exifCache.set(img, text);
        callback(text);
      });
    };
    if (img.complete) run();
    else img.addEventListener('load', run, { once: true });
  }

  function removeCaption() {
    const caption = document.getElementById(captionId);
    if (caption) caption.remove();
  }

  function placeCaption(text, target) {
    removeCaption();
    if (!target) return;
    ensureCaptionStyle();
    const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
    const caption = document.createElement('div');
    caption.id = captionId;
    caption.className = captionClass;
    caption.textContent = text;
    caption.style.left = `${Math.max(12, rect.left + window.scrollX)}px`;
    caption.style.top = `${rect.bottom + window.scrollY + 8}px`;
    caption.style.maxWidth = `${Math.min(rect.width, window.innerWidth - 24)}px`;
    document.body.appendChild(caption);
  }

  function setInlineCaption(img, text) {
    if (!img || img.dataset.exifInlineDone) return;
    img.dataset.exifInlineDone = 'true';
    const figure = img.closest('figure');
    if (figure) {
      let figcaption = figure.querySelector('figcaption');
      if (!figcaption) {
        figcaption = document.createElement('figcaption');
        figure.appendChild(figcaption);
      }
      figcaption.classList.add('exif-caption-inline');
      figcaption.textContent = text;
      return;
    }
    const caption = document.createElement('div');
    caption.className = 'exif-caption-inline';
    caption.textContent = text;
    img.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', caption);
  }

  function findOpenedZoomImage() {
    return document.querySelector('.medium-zoom-image--opened');
  }

  function initExifCaption() {
    const inlineImages = document.querySelectorAll('.post-body img');
    inlineImages.forEach(function(img) {
      getExifText(img, function(text) {
        if (!text || text === '无 EXIF 信息') return;
        setInlineCaption(img, text);
      });
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
      const img = event.target.closest('.post-body img');
      if (!img) return;

      setTimeout(function() {
        const zoomed = findOpenedZoomImage();
        if (!zoomed) return;
        getExifText(img, function(text) {
          placeCaption(text, zoomed);
        });
      }, 80);
    });

    document.addEventListener('keyup', function(event) {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') removeCaption();
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
      if (!event.target || !event.target.classList) return;
      if (event.target.classList.contains('medium-zoom-overlay') ||
          event.target.classList.contains('medium-zoom-image--opened')) {
        removeCaption();
      }
    });

    const observer = new MutationObserver(function() {
      if (!findOpenedZoomImage()) removeCaption();
    });
    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initExifCaption);
  } else {
    initExifCaption();
  }
})();
</script>

(function() {
  'use strict';

  function ensureBannerStyle() {
    if (document.getElementById('banner-carousel-style')) return;
    const style = document.createElement('style');
    style.id = 'banner-carousel-style';
    style.textContent = `
      .banner-carousel {

        height: clamp(280px, 55vw, 520px);

      .banner-slide.is-prev,

      .banner-slide img {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        object-fit: contain;

        transition: transform 0.5s ease;
      }
      .banner-prev,
      .banner-next {
        position: absolute;
        top: 50%;
        transform: translateY(-50%);
        background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
        color: #fff;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
        width: 44px;
        height: 44px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        cursor: pointer;
        z-index: 20;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        font-size: 24px;
        line-height: 1;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
        backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      }
      .banner-prev:hover,
      .banner-next:hover {
        background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
        transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1.1);
      }
      .banner-prev { left: 20px; }
      .banner-next { right: 20px; }
      .banner-dots {
        position: absolute;
        left: 50%;
        bottom: 15px;
        transform: translateX(-50%);
        display: flex;
        gap: 8px;
        z-index: 20;
      }
      .banner-dot {
        width: 8px;
        height: 8px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
      }
      .banner-dot.active {
        background: #fff;
        transform: scale(1.2);
        box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      }
      
      @media (max-width: 768px) {
        .banner-carousel {
          height: clamp(220px, 70vw, 360px);
        }
        .banner-slide {
          flex: 0 0 85%;
          margin: 0 6px;
        }
        .banner-prev, .banner-next {
          width: 32px;
          height: 32px;
          font-size: 18px;
        }
      }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
  }

  function initCarousel(carousel) {
    const track = carousel.querySelector('.banner-track');
    const slides = Array.from(carousel.querySelectorAll('.banner-slide'));
    let prevBtn = carousel.querySelector('.banner-prev');
    let nextBtn = carousel.querySelector('.banner-next');
    let dotsWrap = carousel.querySelector('.banner-dots');
    const autoplay = Number(carousel.dataset.autoplay || 0);
    let index = 0;
    let timer = null;

    if (!track || slides.length === 0) return;

    if (!prevBtn) {
      prevBtn = document.createElement('button');
      prevBtn.type = 'button';
      prevBtn.className = 'banner-prev';
      prevBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Previous slide');
      prevBtn.innerHTML = '‹';
      carousel.appendChild(prevBtn);
    }

    if (!nextBtn) {
      nextBtn = document.createElement('button');
      nextBtn.type = 'button';
      nextBtn.className = 'banner-next';
      nextBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Next slide');
      nextBtn.innerHTML = '›';
      carousel.appendChild(nextBtn);
    }

    if (!dotsWrap) {
      dotsWrap = document.createElement('div');
      dotsWrap.className = 'banner-dots';
      carousel.appendChild(dotsWrap);
    }

    dotsWrap.innerHTML = '';
    const dots = slides.map(function(_, i) {
      const dot = document.createElement('span');
      dot.className = 'banner-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
      dot.addEventListener('click', function() {
        goTo(i);
      });
      dotsWrap.appendChild(dot);
      return dot;
    });

    slides.forEach(function(slide, i) {
      slide.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (index !== i) goTo(i);
      });
    });

    function update() {
      const containerWidth = carousel.offsetWidth;
      const slide = slides[0];
      const style = window.getComputedStyle(slide);
      const slideWidth = slide.offsetWidth;
      const margin = parseFloat(style.marginLeft) + parseFloat(style.marginRight);
      const fullSlideWidth = slideWidth + margin;
      const prevIndex = (index - 1 + slides.length) % slides.length;
      const nextIndex = (index + 1) % slides.length;

      const trackShift = (containerWidth / 2) - ((index * fullSlideWidth) + (fullSlideWidth / 2));
      
      track.style.transform = `translateX(${trackShift}px)`;

      slides.forEach(function(s, i) {
        s.classList.toggle('active', i === index);
        s.classList.toggle('is-prev', i === prevIndex);
        s.classList.toggle('is-next', i === nextIndex);
      });
      dots.forEach(function(d, i) {
        d.classList.toggle('active', i === index);
      });
    }

    function goTo(i) {
      index = (i + slides.length) % slides.length;
      update();
    }

    function next() {
      goTo(index + 1);
    }

    function prev() {
      goTo(index - 1);
    }

    if (nextBtn) nextBtn.addEventListener('click', next);
    if (prevBtn) prevBtn.addEventListener('click', prev);

    window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
      requestAnimationFrame(update);
    });

    setTimeout(update, 50);

    if (autoplay > 0) {
      const start = function() {
        timer = setInterval(next, autoplay);
      };
      const stop = function() {
        if (timer) clearInterval(timer);
        timer = null;
      };
      carousel.addEventListener('mouseenter', stop);
      carousel.addEventListener('mouseleave', start);
      start();
    }
  }

  function initBannerCarousels() {
    ensureBannerStyle();
    document.querySelectorAll('.banner-carousel').forEach(initCarousel);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initBannerCarousels);
  } else {
    initBannerCarousels();
  }
})();
</script>

Post.title: 性能指标详解
Post.description: 在开发测试网站时需要了解的性能指标，包括吞吐量、并发数、QPS、TPS等重要概念
Post.keywords: 性能指标, 吞吐量, QPS, TPS, 并发数, 性能测试
Post._content:
### 简述
```
在开发测试网站时，一般都有几个指标来衡量系统的性能，其中吞吐量、并发数、QPS、TPS、有效吞吐量、吞吐率、网络流量等指标，接下来就这几种指标简单聊聊。
```

#### 吞吐量

* 引用维基百科的概念解释

![alt text](../img/performance/image.png)

* Web系统
```
在web系统中，吞吐量指单位时间内成功处理的请求数量，反应了系统的整体性能，高吞吐量意味着用户的体验更好，请求可以被更快速的处理和响应。
```
* AI大模型训练

```
在大模型训练中，吞吐量指单位时间内可以处理多少个训练步骤或样本，
```
* 数据库

```
在数据库这样的存储系统中，吞吐量指可以接受和写入存储的数据量或读取并返回到请求系统中的数据量，通常以每秒字节数(Bps)为单位。
```
* JVM

```
Java JVM中的Parallel Scavenge垃圾收集器，重点是关注的吞吐量，逻辑为：运行用户代码时间/(运行用户代码时间+运行垃圾收集时间)
```

* 吞吐量和什么有关
```
吞吐量一般和网络带宽有关，但是吞吐量必然低于带宽，最主要的还是和系统的性能有很大关系，一般低延迟的系统吞吐量必然也不低。
```
* 如何测试吞吐量

```
可以采用网络工具来检测，比如简单网络管理协议 （SNMP）、Windows Management Instrumentation （WMI）、tcpdump、Wireshark 等
```
* 参考

[1.TeachTarget throughput](https://www.techtarget.com/searchnetworking/definition/throughput)

[2.性能测试中吞吐量](https://aiops.com/news/post/33883.html)

      color: #f0f0f0;
    }
    
    body.dark blockquote {
      background-color: #2d2d2d;
      border-left-color: #0070f3;
      color: #d0d0d0;
    }
    
    body.dark .pagination .page-number {
      background-color: #2d2d2d;
      color: #e0e0e0;
      border-color: #404040;
    }
    
    body.dark .pagination .page-number:hover {
      background-color: #404040;
    }
    
    body.dark .main-inner {
      background-color: #1a1a1a;
    }
    
    body.dark .content-wrap {
      background-color: #1a1a1a;
    }
    
    /* Chart.js 暗黑模式适配 */
    body.dark canvas {
      filter: brightness(0.9) contrast(1.1);
    }
    
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .dark-mode-toggle {
        top: 10px;
        right: 10px;
        width: 40px;
        height: 20px;
        border-radius: 10px;
      }
      
      .dark-mode-toggle .toggle-icon {
        width: 16px;
        height: 16px;
        font-size: 9px;
      }
      
      body.dark .dark-mode-toggle .toggle-icon {
        transform: translateX(18px);
      }
    }
  `;
  
  // 注入CSS
  const style = document.createElement('style');
  style.textContent = darkModeCSS;
  document.head.appendChild(style);
  
  // 检测系统主题偏好
  function getSystemTheme() {
    return window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
  }
  
  // 获取用户主题偏好（兼容旧键名）
  function getUserTheme() {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('color-scheme') || localStorage.getItem('dark-mode');
    if (saved === 'dark' || saved === 'light') return saved === 'dark';
    if (saved !== null) return saved === 'true';
    return getSystemTheme(); // 默认跟随系统
  }
  
  // 应用主题（同步 html data-theme 与 body.dark，兼容自定义样式与 NexT 变量）
  function applyTheme(isDark) {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
    document.body.classList.toggle('dark', isDark);
  }
  
  // 创建切换按钮
  function createToggleButton() {
    const button = document.createElement('button');
    button.className = 'dark-mode-toggle';
    button.title = '切换暗黑模式';
    
    const icon = document.createElement('div');
    icon.className = 'toggle-icon';
    icon.innerHTML = '☀';
    button.appendChild(icon);
    
    // 初始化主题
    const isDark = getUserTheme();
    applyTheme(isDark);
    updateIcon(icon, isDark);
    
    // 点击事件
    button.addEventListener('click', function() {
      const currentlyDark = document.body.classList.contains('dark');
      const newDark = !currentlyDark;
      
      applyTheme(newDark);
      updateIcon(icon, newDark);
      
      // 保存到本地存储（兼容旧键）
      localStorage.setItem('color-scheme', newDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
      localStorage.setItem('dark-mode', newDark);
      
      // 平滑动画
      document.body.style.transition = 'background-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease';
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.body.style.transition = '';
      }, 300);
    });
    
    document.body.appendChild(button);
  }
  
  // 更新图标
  function updateIcon(icon, isDark) {
    if (isDark) {
      icon.innerHTML = '🌙';
    } else {
      icon.innerHTML = '☀';
    }
  }
  
  // 监听系统主题变化（仅在未手动设置时跟随）
  function watchSystemTheme() {
    if (!window.matchMedia) return;
    const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    const handler = function(e) {
      if (localStorage.getItem('color-scheme') === null && localStorage.getItem('dark-mode') === null) {
        const isDark = e.matches;
        const icon = document.querySelector('.toggle-icon');
        applyTheme(isDark);
        if (icon) updateIcon(icon, isDark);
      }
    };
    if (mediaQuery.addEventListener) mediaQuery.addEventListener('change', handler);
    else if (mediaQuery.addListener) mediaQuery.addListener(handler);
  }
  
  // 页面加载完成后创建按钮
  function init() {
    createToggleButton();
    watchSystemTheme();
  }
  
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
  
})();
</script>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/exif-js@2.3.0/exif.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function() {
  'use strict';

  const captionClass = 'exif-caption';
  const captionId = 'exif-caption-overlay';
  const exifCache = new WeakMap();

  function ensureCaptionStyle() {
    if (document.getElementById('exif-caption-style')) return;
    const style = document.createElement('style');
    style.id = 'exif-caption-style';
    style.textContent = `
      .${captionClass} {
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 1001;
        padding: 6px 10px;
        border-radius: 6px;
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.4;
        color: #fff;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65);
        max-width: 90vw;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        pointer-events: none;
        text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      }
      .exif-caption-inline {
        margin-top: 6px;
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.4;
        color: var(--text-color, #666);
        text-align: left;
        word-break: break-word;
      }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
  }

  function formatExposure(value) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) return '';
    if (typeof value === 'string') return value.includes('/') ? `${value}s` : value;
    if (typeof value === 'number') {
      if (value >= 1) return `${value}s`;
      const denom = Math.round(1 / value);
      return `1/${denom}s`;
    }
    return '';
  }

  function formatFNumber(value) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) return '';
    if (typeof value === 'string') return value.toLowerCase().startsWith('f') ? value : `f/${value}`;
    if (typeof value === 'number') return `f/${value}`;
    return '';
  }

  function formatFocalLength(value) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) return '';
    if (typeof value === 'string') return value.includes('mm') ? value : `${value}mm`;
    if (typeof value === 'number') return `${value}mm`;
    return '';
  }

  function normalizeTags(tags) {
    const make = tags.Make || '';
    const model = tags.Model || '';
    const lens = tags.LensModel || tags.LensMake || '';
    const exposure = formatExposure(tags.ExposureTime);
    const fNumber = formatFNumber(tags.FNumber || tags.ApertureValue);
    const iso = tags.ISOSpeedRatings || tags.ISO || '';
    const focal = formatFocalLength(tags.FocalLength);
    const date = tags.DateTimeOriginal || tags.DateTime || '';

    const parts = [];
    const camera = `${make} ${model}`.trim();
    if (camera) parts.push(camera);
    if (lens) parts.push(lens);
    const settings = [exposure, fNumber, iso ? `ISO ${iso}` : '', focal].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
    if (settings) parts.push(settings);
    if (date) parts.push(date);
    return parts.length ? parts.join(' / ') : '无 EXIF 信息';
  }

  function getExifText(img, callback) {
    if (exifCache.has(img)) {
      callback(exifCache.get(img));
      return;
    }
    if (!window.EXIF) {
      callback('EXIF 库未加载');
      return;
    }
    const run = function() {
      window.EXIF.getData(img, function() {
        const tags = window.EXIF.getAllTags(this) || {};
        const text = normalizeTags(tags);
        exifCache.set(img, text);
        callback(text);
      });
    };
    if (img.complete) run();
    else img.addEventListener('load', run, { once: true });
  }

  function removeCaption() {
    const caption = document.getElementById(captionId);
    if (caption) caption.remove();
  }

  function placeCaption(text, target) {
    removeCaption();
    if (!target) return;
    ensureCaptionStyle();
    const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
    const caption = document.createElement('div');
    caption.id = captionId;
    caption.className = captionClass;
    caption.textContent = text;
    caption.style.left = `${Math.max(12, rect.left + window.scrollX)}px`;
    caption.style.top = `${rect.bottom + window.scrollY + 8}px`;
    caption.style.maxWidth = `${Math.min(rect.width, window.innerWidth - 24)}px`;
    document.body.appendChild(caption);
  }

  function setInlineCaption(img, text) {
    if (!img || img.dataset.exifInlineDone) return;
    img.dataset.exifInlineDone = 'true';
    const figure = img.closest('figure');
    if (figure) {
      let figcaption = figure.querySelector('figcaption');
      if (!figcaption) {
        figcaption = document.createElement('figcaption');
        figure.appendChild(figcaption);
      }
      figcaption.classList.add('exif-caption-inline');
      figcaption.textContent = text;
      return;
    }
    const caption = document.createElement('div');
    caption.className = 'exif-caption-inline';
    caption.textContent = text;
    img.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', caption);
  }

  function findOpenedZoomImage() {
    return document.querySelector('.medium-zoom-image--opened');
  }

  function initExifCaption() {
    const inlineImages = document.querySelectorAll('.post-body img');
    inlineImages.forEach(function(img) {
      getExifText(img, function(text) {
        if (!text || text === '无 EXIF 信息') return;
        setInlineCaption(img, text);
      });
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
      const img = event.target.closest('.post-body img');
      if (!img) return;

      setTimeout(function() {
        const zoomed = findOpenedZoomImage();
        if (!zoomed) return;
        getExifText(img, function(text) {
          placeCaption(text, zoomed);
        });
      }, 80);
    });

    document.addEventListener('keyup', function(event) {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') removeCaption();
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
      if (!event.target || !event.target.classList) return;
      if (event.target.classList.contains('medium-zoom-overlay') ||
          event.target.classList.contains('medium-zoom-image--opened')) {
        removeCaption();
      }
    });

    const observer = new MutationObserver(function() {
      if (!findOpenedZoomImage()) removeCaption();
    });
    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initExifCaption);
  } else {
    initExifCaption();
  }
})();
</script>

  function ensureBannerStyle() {

    style.textContent = `

        transition: all 0.3s ease;

      }
      .banner-prev:hover,
      .banner-next:hover {
        background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
        transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1.1);
      }
      .banner-prev { left: 20px; }
      .banner-next { right: 20px; }
      .banner-dots {
        position: absolute;
        left: 50%;
        bottom: 15px;
        transform: translateX(-50%);
        display: flex;
        gap: 8px;
        z-index: 20;
      }
      .banner-dot {
        width: 8px;
        height: 8px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
      }
      .banner-dot.active {
        background: #fff;
        transform: scale(1.2);
        box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      }
      
      @media (max-width: 768px) {
        .banner-carousel {
          height: clamp(220px, 70vw, 360px);
        }
        .banner-slide {
          flex: 0 0 85%;
          margin: 0 6px;
        }
        .banner-prev, .banner-next {
          width: 32px;
          height: 32px;
          font-size: 18px;
        }
      }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
  }

  function initCarousel(carousel) {
    const track = carousel.querySelector('.banner-track');
    const slides = Array.from(carousel.querySelectorAll('.banner-slide'));
    let prevBtn = carousel.querySelector('.banner-prev');
    let nextBtn = carousel.querySelector('.banner-next');
    let dotsWrap = carousel.querySelector('.banner-dots');
    const autoplay = Number(carousel.dataset.autoplay || 0);
    let index = 0;
    let timer = null;

    if (!track || slides.length === 0) return;

    if (!prevBtn) {
      prevBtn = document.createElement('button');
      prevBtn.type = 'button';
      prevBtn.className = 'banner-prev';
      prevBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Previous slide');
      prevBtn.innerHTML = '‹';
      carousel.appendChild(prevBtn);
    }

    if (!nextBtn) {
      nextBtn = document.createElement('button');
      nextBtn.type = 'button';
      nextBtn.className = 'banner-next';
      nextBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Next slide');
      nextBtn.innerHTML = '›';
      carousel.appendChild(nextBtn);
    }

    if (!dotsWrap) {
      dotsWrap = document.createElement('div');
      dotsWrap.className = 'banner-dots';
      carousel.appendChild(dotsWrap);
    }

    dotsWrap.innerHTML = '';
    const dots = slides.map(function(_, i) {
      const dot = document.createElement('span');
      dot.className = 'banner-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
      dot.addEventListener('click', function() {
        goTo(i);
      });
      dotsWrap.appendChild(dot);
      return dot;
    });

    slides.forEach(function(slide, i) {
      slide.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (index !== i) goTo(i);
      });
    });

    function update() {
      const containerWidth = carousel.offsetWidth;
      const slide = slides[0];
      const style = window.getComputedStyle(slide);
      const slideWidth = slide.offsetWidth;
      const margin = parseFloat(style.marginLeft) + parseFloat(style.marginRight);
      const fullSlideWidth = slideWidth + margin;
      const prevIndex = (index - 1 + slides.length) % slides.length;
      const nextIndex = (index + 1) % slides.length;

      const trackShift = (containerWidth / 2) - ((index * fullSlideWidth) + (fullSlideWidth / 2));
      
      track.style.transform = `translateX(${trackShift}px)`;

      slides.forEach(function(s, i) {
        s.classList.toggle('active', i === index);
        s.classList.toggle('is-prev', i === prevIndex);
        s.classList.toggle('is-next', i === nextIndex);
      });
      dots.forEach(function(d, i) {
        d.classList.toggle('active', i === index);
      });
    }

    function goTo(i) {
      index = (i + slides.length) % slides.length;
      update();
    }

    function next() {
      goTo(index + 1);
    }

    function prev() {
      goTo(index - 1);
    }

    if (nextBtn) nextBtn.addEventListener('click', next);
    if (prevBtn) prevBtn.addEventListener('click', prev);

    window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
      requestAnimationFrame(update);
    });

    setTimeout(update, 50);

    if (autoplay > 0) {
      const start = function() {
        timer = setInterval(next, autoplay);
      };
      const stop = function() {
        if (timer) clearInterval(timer);
        timer = null;
      };
      carousel.addEventListener('mouseenter', stop);
      carousel.addEventListener('mouseleave', start);
      start();
    }
  }

  function initBannerCarousels() {
    ensureBannerStyle();
    document.querySelectorAll('.banner-carousel').forEach(initCarousel);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initBannerCarousels);
  } else {
    initBannerCarousels();
  }
})();
</script>

Post.more:
简述

在开发测试网站时，一般都有几个指标来衡量系统的性能，其中吞吐量、并发数、QPS、TPS、有效吞吐量、吞吐率、网络流量等指标，接下来就这几种指标简单聊聊。

吞吐量

  • 引用维基百科的概念解释

  • Web系统
    在web系统中，吞吐量指单位时间内成功处理的请求数量，反应了系统的整体性能，高吞吐量意味着用户的体验更好，请求可以被更快速的处理和响应。
  • AI大模型训练
在大模型训练中，吞吐量指单位时间内可以处理多少个训练步骤或样本，
  • 数据库
在数据库这样的存储系统中，吞吐量指可以接受和写入存储的数据量或读取并返回到请求系统中的数据量，通常以每秒字节数(Bps)为单位。
  • JVM
Java JVM中的Parallel Scavenge垃圾收集器，重点是关注的吞吐量，逻辑为：运行用户代码时间/(运行用户代码时间+运行垃圾收集时间)
  • 吞吐量和什么有关
    吞吐量一般和网络带宽有关，但是吞吐量必然低于带宽，最主要的还是和系统的性能有很大关系，一般低延迟的系统吞吐量必然也不低。
  • 如何测试吞吐量
可以采用网络工具来检测，比如简单网络管理协议 （SNMP）、Windows Management Instrumentation （WMI）、tcpdump、Wireshark 等

  // 注入CSS
  const style = document.createElement('style');
  style.textContent = darkModeCSS;
  document.head.appendChild(style);
  
  // 检测系统主题偏好
  function getSystemTheme() {
    return window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
  }
  
  // 获取用户主题偏好（兼容旧键名）
  function getUserTheme() {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('color-scheme') || localStorage.getItem('dark-mode');
    if (saved === 'dark' || saved === 'light') return saved === 'dark';
    if (saved !== null) return saved === 'true';
    return getSystemTheme(); // 默认跟随系统
  }
  
  // 应用主题（同步 html data-theme 与 body.dark，兼容自定义样式与 NexT 变量）
  function applyTheme(isDark) {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
    document.body.classList.toggle('dark', isDark);
  }
  
  // 创建切换按钮
  function createToggleButton() {
    const button = document.createElement('button');
    button.className = 'dark-mode-toggle';
    button.title = '切换暗黑模式';
    
    const icon = document.createElement('div');
    icon.className = 'toggle-icon';
    icon.innerHTML = '☀';
    button.appendChild(icon);
    
    // 初始化主题
    const isDark = getUserTheme();
    applyTheme(isDark);
    updateIcon(icon, isDark);
    
    // 点击事件
    button.addEventListener('click', function() {
      const currentlyDark = document.body.classList.contains('dark');
      const newDark = !currentlyDark;
      
      applyTheme(newDark);
      updateIcon(icon, newDark);
      
      // 保存到本地存储（兼容旧键）
      localStorage.setItem('color-scheme', newDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
      localStorage.setItem('dark-mode', newDark);
      
      // 平滑动画
      document.body.style.transition = 'background-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease';
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.body.style.transition = '';
      }, 300);
    });
    
    document.body.appendChild(button);
  }
  
  // 更新图标
  function updateIcon(icon, isDark) {
    if (isDark) {
      icon.innerHTML = '🌙';
    } else {
      icon.innerHTML = '☀';
    }
  }
  
  // 监听系统主题变化（仅在未手动设置时跟随）
  function watchSystemTheme() {
    if (!window.matchMedia) return;
    const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    const handler = function(e) {
      if (localStorage.getItem('color-scheme') === null && localStorage.getItem('dark-mode') === null) {
        const isDark = e.matches;
        const icon = document.querySelector('.toggle-icon');
        applyTheme(isDark);
        if (icon) updateIcon(icon, isDark);
      }
    };
    if (mediaQuery.addEventListener) mediaQuery.addEventListener('change', handler);
    else if (mediaQuery.addListener) mediaQuery.addListener(handler);
  }
  
  // 页面加载完成后创建按钮
  function init() {
    createToggleButton();
    watchSystemTheme();
  }
  
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
  
})();
</script>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/exif-js@2.3.0/exif.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function() {
  'use strict';

  const captionClass = 'exif-caption';
  const captionId = 'exif-caption-overlay';
  const exifCache = new WeakMap();

  function ensureCaptionStyle() {
    if (document.getElementById('exif-caption-style')) return;
    const style = document.createElement('style');
    style.id = 'exif-caption-style';
    style.textContent = `
      .${captionClass} {
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 1001;
        padding: 6px 10px;
        border-radius: 6px;
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.4;
        color: #fff;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65);
        max-width: 90vw;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        pointer-events: none;
        text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      }
      .exif-caption-inline {
        margin-top: 6px;
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.4;
        color: var(--text-color, #666);
        text-align: left;
        word-break: break-word;
      }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
  }

  function formatExposure(value) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) return '';
    if (typeof value === 'string') return value.includes('/') ? `${value}s` : value;
    if (typeof value === 'number') {
      if (value >= 1) return `${value}s`;
      const denom = Math.round(1 / value);
      return `1/${denom}s`;
    }
    return '';
  }

  function formatFNumber(value) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) return '';
    if (typeof value === 'string') return value.toLowerCase().startsWith('f') ? value : `f/${value}`;
    if (typeof value === 'number') return `f/${value}`;
    return '';
  }

  function formatFocalLength(value) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) return '';
    if (typeof value === 'string') return value.includes('mm') ? value : `${value}mm`;
    if (typeof value === 'number') return `${value}mm`;
    return '';
  }

  function normalizeTags(tags) {
    const make = tags.Make || '';
    const model = tags.Model || '';
    const lens = tags.LensModel || tags.LensMake || '';
    const exposure = formatExposure(tags.ExposureTime);
    const fNumber = formatFNumber(tags.FNumber || tags.ApertureValue);
    const iso = tags.ISOSpeedRatings || tags.ISO || '';
    const focal = formatFocalLength(tags.FocalLength);
    const date = tags.DateTimeOriginal || tags.DateTime || '';

    const parts = [];
    const camera = `${make} ${model}`.trim();
    if (camera) parts.push(camera);
    if (lens) parts.push(lens);
    const settings = [exposure, fNumber, iso ? `ISO ${iso}` : '', focal].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
    if (settings) parts.push(settings);
    if (date) parts.push(date);
    return parts.length ? parts.join(' / ') : '无 EXIF 信息';
  }

  function getExifText(img, callback) {
    if (exifCache.has(img)) {
      callback(exifCache.get(img));
      return;
    }
    if (!window.EXIF) {
      callback('EXIF 库未加载');
      return;
    }
    const run = function() {
      window.EXIF.getData(img, function() {
        const tags = window.EXIF.getAllTags(this) || {};
        const text = normalizeTags(tags);
        exifCache.set(img, text);
        callback(text);
      });
    };
    if (img.complete) run();
    else img.addEventListener('load', run, { once: true });
  }

  function removeCaption() {
    const caption = document.getElementById(captionId);
    if (caption) caption.remove();
  }

  function placeCaption(text, target) {
    removeCaption();
    if (!target) return;
    ensureCaptionStyle();
    const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
    const caption = document.createElement('div');
    caption.id = captionId;
    caption.className = captionClass;
    caption.textContent = text;
    caption.style.left = `${Math.max(12, rect.left + window.scrollX)}px`;
    caption.style.top = `${rect.bottom + window.scrollY + 8}px`;
    caption.style.maxWidth = `${Math.min(rect.width, window.innerWidth - 24)}px`;
    document.body.appendChild(caption);
  }

  function setInlineCaption(img, text) {
    if (!img || img.dataset.exifInlineDone) return;
    img.dataset.exifInlineDone = 'true';
    const figure = img.closest('figure');
    if (figure) {
      let figcaption = figure.querySelector('figcaption');
      if (!figcaption) {
        figcaption = document.createElement('figcaption');
        figure.appendChild(figcaption);
      }
      figcaption.classList.add('exif-caption-inline');
      figcaption.textContent = text;
      return;
    }
    const caption = document.createElement('div');
    caption.className = 'exif-caption-inline';
    caption.textContent = text;
    img.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', caption);
  }

  function findOpenedZoomImage() {
    return document.querySelector('.medium-zoom-image--opened');
  }

  function initExifCaption() {
    const inlineImages = document.querySelectorAll('.post-body img');
    inlineImages.forEach(function(img) {
      getExifText(img, function(text) {
        if (!text || text === '无 EXIF 信息') return;
        setInlineCaption(img, text);
      });
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
      const img = event.target.closest('.post-body img');
      if (!img) return;

      setTimeout(function() {
        const zoomed = findOpenedZoomImage();
        if (!zoomed) return;
        getExifText(img, function(text) {
          placeCaption(text, zoomed);
        });
      }, 80);
    });

    document.addEventListener('keyup', function(event) {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') removeCaption();
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
      if (!event.target || !event.target.classList) return;
      if (event.target.classList.contains('medium-zoom-overlay') ||
          event.target.classList.contains('medium-zoom-image--opened')) {
        removeCaption();
      }
    });

    const observer = new MutationObserver(function() {
      if (!findOpenedZoomImage()) removeCaption();
    });
    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initExifCaption);
  } else {
    initExifCaption();
  }
})();
</script>

  function ensureBannerStyle() {
    if (document.getElementById('banner-carousel-style')) return;

    style.textContent = `

      }
      .banner-prev:hover,
      .banner-next:hover {
        background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
        transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1.1);
      }
      .banner-prev { left: 20px; }
      .banner-next { right: 20px; }
      .banner-dots {
        position: absolute;
        left: 50%;
        bottom: 15px;
        transform: translateX(-50%);
        display: flex;
        gap: 8px;
        z-index: 20;
      }
      .banner-dot {
        width: 8px;
        height: 8px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
      }
      .banner-dot.active {

      @media (max-width: 768px) {

        }
        .banner-slide {
          flex: 0 0 85%;

          height: 32px;
          font-size: 18px;
        }
      }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
  }

  function initCarousel(carousel) {
    const track = carousel.querySelector('.banner-track');
    const slides = Array.from(carousel.querySelectorAll('.banner-slide'));
    let prevBtn = carousel.querySelector('.banner-prev');
    let nextBtn = carousel.querySelector('.banner-next');
    let dotsWrap = carousel.querySelector('.banner-dots');
    const autoplay = Number(carousel.dataset.autoplay || 0);
    let index = 0;
    let timer = null;

    if (!track || slides.length === 0) return;

    if (!prevBtn) {
      prevBtn = document.createElement('button');
      prevBtn.type = 'button';
      prevBtn.className = 'banner-prev';
      prevBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Previous slide');
      prevBtn.innerHTML = '‹';
      carousel.appendChild(prevBtn);
    }

    if (!nextBtn) {
      nextBtn = document.createElement('button');
      nextBtn.type = 'button';
      nextBtn.className = 'banner-next';
      nextBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Next slide');
      nextBtn.innerHTML = '›';
      carousel.appendChild(nextBtn);
    }

    if (!dotsWrap) {
      dotsWrap = document.createElement('div');
      dotsWrap.className = 'banner-dots';
      carousel.appendChild(dotsWrap);
    }

    dotsWrap.innerHTML = '';
    const dots = slides.map(function(_, i) {
      const dot = document.createElement('span');
      dot.className = 'banner-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
      dot.addEventListener('click', function() {
        goTo(i);
      });
      dotsWrap.appendChild(dot);
      return dot;
    });

    slides.forEach(function(slide, i) {
      slide.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (index !== i) goTo(i);
      });
    });

    function update() {
      const containerWidth = carousel.offsetWidth;
      const slide = slides[0];
      const style = window.getComputedStyle(slide);
      const slideWidth = slide.offsetWidth;
      const margin = parseFloat(style.marginLeft) + parseFloat(style.marginRight);
      const fullSlideWidth = slideWidth + margin;
      const prevIndex = (index - 1 + slides.length) % slides.length;
      const nextIndex = (index + 1) % slides.length;

      const trackShift = (containerWidth / 2) - ((index * fullSlideWidth) + (fullSlideWidth / 2));
      
      track.style.transform = `translateX(${trackShift}px)`;

      slides.forEach(function(s, i) {
        s.classList.toggle('active', i === index);
        s.classList.toggle('is-prev', i === prevIndex);
        s.classList.toggle('is-next', i === nextIndex);
      });
      dots.forEach(function(d, i) {
        d.classList.toggle('active', i === index);
      });
    }

    function goTo(i) {
      index = (i + slides.length) % slides.length;
      update();
    }

    function next() {
      goTo(index + 1);
    }

    function prev() {
      goTo(index - 1);
    }

    if (nextBtn) nextBtn.addEventListener('click', next);
    if (prevBtn) prevBtn.addEventListener('click', prev);

    window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
      requestAnimationFrame(update);
    });

    setTimeout(update, 50);

    if (autoplay > 0) {
      const start = function() {
        timer = setInterval(next, autoplay);
      };
      const stop = function() {
        if (timer) clearInterval(timer);
        timer = null;
      };
      carousel.addEventListener('mouseenter', stop);
      carousel.addEventListener('mouseleave', start);
      start();
    }
  }

  function initBannerCarousels() {
    ensureBannerStyle();
    document.querySelectorAll('.banner-carousel').forEach(initCarousel);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initBannerCarousels);
  } else {
    initBannerCarousels();
  }
})();
</script>

Post.title: Java 开发中的性能优化技巧
Post.description: 分享在 Java 开发中常用的性能优化技巧，帮助提升应用程序的执行效率
Post.content:
Java 开发中的性能优化技巧

在 Java 开发过程中，性能优化是一个永恒的话题。今天我来分享一些实用的性能优化技巧，这些技巧在实际项目中都经过验证。

1. 合理使用集合框架

ArrayList vs LinkedList

// 频繁随机访问时使用 ArrayList
List<String> arrayList = new ArrayList<>();

// 频繁插入删除时使用 LinkedList
List<String> linkedList = new LinkedList<>();

HashMap 初始容量设置

// 避免频繁扩容，预设合理的初始容量
Map<String, Object> map = new HashMap<>(16);

// 如果知道大概数据量，可以这样计算
int expectedSize = 1000;
Map<String, Object> optimizedMap = new HashMap<>(expectedSize / 0.75f + 1);

2. 字符串操作优化

使用 StringBuilder

// 避免这样做
String result = "";
for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {
    result += "item" + i;
}

// 推荐这样做
StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {
    sb.append("item").append(i);
}
String result = sb.toString();

字符串常量池

// 使用字符串常量池
String s1 = "hello";

// 避免不必要的 new String()
String s2 = new String("hello"); // 不推荐

3. 对象创建优化

对象重用

// 重用 SimpleDateFormat
private static final ThreadLocal<SimpleDateFormat> DATE_FORMAT = 
    ThreadLocal.withInitial(() -> new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd"));

public String formatDate(Date date) {
    return DATE_FORMAT.get().format(date);
}

避免在循环中创建对象

// 避免这样做
for (int i = 0; i < 10000; i++) {
    String temp = new String("temp");
    // do something
}

// 推荐这样做
String temp = "temp";
for (int i = 0; i < 10000; i++) {
    // do something with temp
}

4. 数据库操作优化

批量操作

// 使用批量插入
String sql = "INSERT INTO user (name, email) VALUES (?, ?)";
try (PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {
    for (User user : users) {
        ps.setString(1, user.getName());
        ps.setString(2, user.getEmail());
        ps.addBatch();
    }
    ps.executeBatch();
}

连接池配置

# application.yml
spring:
  datasource:
    hikari:
      maximum-pool-size: 20
      minimum-idle: 5
      connection-timeout: 30000
      idle-timeout: 600000
      max-lifetime: 1800000

5. JVM 参数调优

堆内存设置

# 设置堆内存大小
-Xms2g -Xmx2g

# 设置新生代比例
-XX:NewRatio=3

# 启用 G1GC
-XX:+UseG1GC
-XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200

监控和诊断

# 启用 GC 日志
-XX:+PrintGC
-XX:+PrintGCDetails
-XX:+PrintGCTimeStamps

# 开启远程监控
-Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote
-Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.port=9999
-Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.authenticate=false
-Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.ssl=false

6. 缓存策略

本地缓存

@Component
public class CacheService {
    
    private final Cache<String, Object> cache = Caffeine.newBuilder()
            .maximumSize(10000)
            .expireAfterWrite(Duration.ofMinutes(5))
            .build();
    
    public Object get(String key) {
        return cache.getIfPresent(key);
    }
    
    public void put(String key, Object value) {
        cache.put(key, value);
    }
}

Redis 缓存

@Service
public class UserService {
    
    @Cacheable(value = "users", key = "#id")
    public User getUserById(Long id) {
        return userRepository.findById(id);
    }
    
    @CacheEvict(value = "users", key = "#user.id")
    public void updateUser(User user) {
        userRepository.save(user);
    }
}

总结

性能优化是一个持续的过程，需要：

  1. 测量先行: 使用性能分析工具定位瓶颈
  2. 合理优化: 针对真正的性能瓶颈进行优化
  3. 权衡取舍: 在代码可读性和性能之间找到平衡
  4. 持续监控: 在生产环境中持续监控性能指标

记住：”过早的优化是万恶之源”，但合理的优化能显著提升用户体验。

如果这篇文章对你有帮助，欢迎点赞和分享！有任何问题也欢迎在评论区讨论。

  const style = document.createElement('style');
  style.textContent = darkModeCSS;
  document.head.appendChild(style);
  
  // 检测系统主题偏好
  function getSystemTheme() {
    return window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
  }
  
  // 获取用户主题偏好（兼容旧键名）
  function getUserTheme() {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('color-scheme') || localStorage.getItem('dark-mode');
    if (saved === 'dark' || saved === 'light') return saved === 'dark';
    if (saved !== null) return saved === 'true';
    return getSystemTheme(); // 默认跟随系统
  }
  
  // 应用主题（同步 html data-theme 与 body.dark，兼容自定义样式与 NexT 变量）
  function applyTheme(isDark) {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
    document.body.classList.toggle('dark', isDark);
  }
  
  // 创建切换按钮
  function createToggleButton() {
    const button = document.createElement('button');
    button.className = 'dark-mode-toggle';
    button.title = '切换暗黑模式';
    
    const icon = document.createElement('div');
    icon.className = 'toggle-icon';
    icon.innerHTML = '☀';
    button.appendChild(icon);
    
    // 初始化主题
    const isDark = getUserTheme();
    applyTheme(isDark);
    updateIcon(icon, isDark);
    
    // 点击事件
    button.addEventListener('click', function() {
      const currentlyDark = document.body.classList.contains('dark');
      const newDark = !currentlyDark;
      
      applyTheme(newDark);
      updateIcon(icon, newDark);
      
      // 保存到本地存储（兼容旧键）
      localStorage.setItem('color-scheme', newDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
      localStorage.setItem('dark-mode', newDark);
      
      // 平滑动画
      document.body.style.transition = 'background-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease';
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.body.style.transition = '';
      }, 300);
    });
    
    document.body.appendChild(button);
  }
  
  // 更新图标
  function updateIcon(icon, isDark) {
    if (isDark) {
      icon.innerHTML = '🌙';
    } else {
      icon.innerHTML = '☀';
    }
  }
  
  // 监听系统主题变化（仅在未手动设置时跟随）
  function watchSystemTheme() {
    if (!window.matchMedia) return;
    const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    const handler = function(e) {
      if (localStorage.getItem('color-scheme') === null && localStorage.getItem('dark-mode') === null) {
        const isDark = e.matches;
        const icon = document.querySelector('.toggle-icon');
        applyTheme(isDark);
        if (icon) updateIcon(icon, isDark);
      }
    };
    if (mediaQuery.addEventListener) mediaQuery.addEventListener('change', handler);
    else if (mediaQuery.addListener) mediaQuery.addListener(handler);
  }
  
  // 页面加载完成后创建按钮
  function init() {
    createToggleButton();
    watchSystemTheme();
  }
  
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
  
})();
</script>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/exif-js@2.3.0/exif.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function() {
  'use strict';

  const captionClass = 'exif-caption';
  const captionId = 'exif-caption-overlay';
  const exifCache = new WeakMap();

  function ensureCaptionStyle() {
    if (document.getElementById('exif-caption-style')) return;
    const style = document.createElement('style');
    style.id = 'exif-caption-style';
    style.textContent = `
      .${captionClass} {
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 1001;
        padding: 6px 10px;
        border-radius: 6px;
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.4;
        color: #fff;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65);
        max-width: 90vw;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        pointer-events: none;
        text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      }
      .exif-caption-inline {
        margin-top: 6px;
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.4;
        color: var(--text-color, #666);
        text-align: left;
        word-break: break-word;
      }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
  }

  function formatExposure(value) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) return '';
    if (typeof value === 'string') return value.includes('/') ? `${value}s` : value;
    if (typeof value === 'number') {
      if (value >= 1) return `${value}s`;
      const denom = Math.round(1 / value);
      return `1/${denom}s`;
    }
    return '';
  }

  function formatFNumber(value) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) return '';
    if (typeof value === 'string') return value.toLowerCase().startsWith('f') ? value : `f/${value}`;
    if (typeof value === 'number') return `f/${value}`;
    return '';
  }

  function formatFocalLength(value) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) return '';
    if (typeof value === 'string') return value.includes('mm') ? value : `${value}mm`;
    if (typeof value === 'number') return `${value}mm`;
    return '';
  }

  function normalizeTags(tags) {
    const make = tags.Make || '';
    const model = tags.Model || '';
    const lens = tags.LensModel || tags.LensMake || '';
    const exposure = formatExposure(tags.ExposureTime);
    const fNumber = formatFNumber(tags.FNumber || tags.ApertureValue);
    const iso = tags.ISOSpeedRatings || tags.ISO || '';
    const focal = formatFocalLength(tags.FocalLength);
    const date = tags.DateTimeOriginal || tags.DateTime || '';

    const parts = [];
    const camera = `${make} ${model}`.trim();
    if (camera) parts.push(camera);
    if (lens) parts.push(lens);
    const settings = [exposure, fNumber, iso ? `ISO ${iso}` : '', focal].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
    if (settings) parts.push(settings);
    if (date) parts.push(date);
    return parts.length ? parts.join(' / ') : '无 EXIF 信息';
  }

  function getExifText(img, callback) {
    if (exifCache.has(img)) {
      callback(exifCache.get(img));
      return;
    }
    if (!window.EXIF) {
      callback('EXIF 库未加载');
      return;
    }
    const run = function() {
      window.EXIF.getData(img, function() {
        const tags = window.EXIF.getAllTags(this) || {};
        const text = normalizeTags(tags);
        exifCache.set(img, text);
        callback(text);
      });
    };
    if (img.complete) run();
    else img.addEventListener('load', run, { once: true });
  }

  function removeCaption() {
    const caption = document.getElementById(captionId);
    if (caption) caption.remove();
  }

  function placeCaption(text, target) {
    removeCaption();
    if (!target) return;
    ensureCaptionStyle();
    const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
    const caption = document.createElement('div');
    caption.id = captionId;
    caption.className = captionClass;
    caption.textContent = text;
    caption.style.left = `${Math.max(12, rect.left + window.scrollX)}px`;
    caption.style.top = `${rect.bottom + window.scrollY + 8}px`;
    caption.style.maxWidth = `${Math.min(rect.width, window.innerWidth - 24)}px`;
    document.body.appendChild(caption);
  }

  function setInlineCaption(img, text) {
    if (!img || img.dataset.exifInlineDone) return;
    img.dataset.exifInlineDone = 'true';
    const figure = img.closest('figure');
    if (figure) {
      let figcaption = figure.querySelector('figcaption');
      if (!figcaption) {
        figcaption = document.createElement('figcaption');
        figure.appendChild(figcaption);
      }
      figcaption.classList.add('exif-caption-inline');
      figcaption.textContent = text;
      return;
    }
    const caption = document.createElement('div');
    caption.className = 'exif-caption-inline';
    caption.textContent = text;
    img.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', caption);
  }

  function findOpenedZoomImage() {
    return document.querySelector('.medium-zoom-image--opened');
  }

  function initExifCaption() {
    const inlineImages = document.querySelectorAll('.post-body img');
    inlineImages.forEach(function(img) {
      getExifText(img, function(text) {
        if (!text || text === '无 EXIF 信息') return;
        setInlineCaption(img, text);
      });
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
      const img = event.target.closest('.post-body img');
      if (!img) return;

      setTimeout(function() {
        const zoomed = findOpenedZoomImage();
        if (!zoomed) return;
        getExifText(img, function(text) {
          placeCaption(text, zoomed);
        });
      }, 80);
    });

    document.addEventListener('keyup', function(event) {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') removeCaption();
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
      if (!event.target || !event.target.classList) return;
      if (event.target.classList.contains('medium-zoom-overlay') ||
          event.target.classList.contains('medium-zoom-image--opened')) {
        removeCaption();
      }
    });

    const observer = new MutationObserver(function() {
      if (!findOpenedZoomImage()) removeCaption();
    });
    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initExifCaption);
  } else {
    initExifCaption();
  }
})();
</script>

        object-fit: contain;
        background: #000;
        transition: transform 0.5s ease;
      }
      .banner-prev,
      .banner-next {
        position: absolute;
        top: 50%;
        transform: translateY(-50%);
        background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
        color: #fff;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
        width: 44px;
        height: 44px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        cursor: pointer;
        z-index: 20;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        font-size: 24px;
        line-height: 1;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
        backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      }
      .banner-prev:hover,
      .banner-next:hover {
        background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
        transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1.1);
      }
      .banner-prev { left: 20px; }
      .banner-next { right: 20px; }
      .banner-dots {
        position: absolute;
        left: 50%;
        bottom: 15px;
        transform: translateX(-50%);
        display: flex;
        gap: 8px;
        z-index: 20;
      }
      .banner-dot {
        width: 8px;
        height: 8px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
      }
      .banner-dot.active {
        background: #fff;
        transform: scale(1.2);
        box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      }
      
      @media (max-width: 768px) {
        .banner-carousel {
          height: clamp(220px, 70vw, 360px);
        }
        .banner-slide {
          flex: 0 0 85%;
          margin: 0 6px;
        }
        .banner-prev, .banner-next {
          width: 32px;
          height: 32px;
          font-size: 18px;
        }
      }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
  }

  function initCarousel(carousel) {
    const track = carousel.querySelector('.banner-track');
    const slides = Array.from(carousel.querySelectorAll('.banner-slide'));
    let prevBtn = carousel.querySelector('.banner-prev');
    let nextBtn = carousel.querySelector('.banner-next');
    let dotsWrap = carousel.querySelector('.banner-dots');
    const autoplay = Number(carousel.dataset.autoplay || 0);
    let index = 0;
    let timer = null;

    if (!track || slides.length === 0) return;

    if (!prevBtn) {
      prevBtn = document.createElement('button');
      prevBtn.type = 'button';
      prevBtn.className = 'banner-prev';
      prevBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Previous slide');
      prevBtn.innerHTML = '‹';
      carousel.appendChild(prevBtn);
    }

    if (!nextBtn) {
      nextBtn = document.createElement('button');
      nextBtn.type = 'button';
      nextBtn.className = 'banner-next';
      nextBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Next slide');
      nextBtn.innerHTML = '›';
      carousel.appendChild(nextBtn);
    }

    if (!dotsWrap) {
      dotsWrap = document.createElement('div');
      dotsWrap.className = 'banner-dots';
      carousel.appendChild(dotsWrap);
    }

    dotsWrap.innerHTML = '';
    const dots = slides.map(function(_, i) {
      const dot = document.createElement('span');
      dot.className = 'banner-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
      dot.addEventListener('click', function() {
        goTo(i);
      });
      dotsWrap.appendChild(dot);
      return dot;
    });

    slides.forEach(function(slide, i) {
      slide.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (index !== i) goTo(i);
      });
    });

    function update() {
      const containerWidth = carousel.offsetWidth;
      const slide = slides[0];
      const style = window.getComputedStyle(slide);
      const slideWidth = slide.offsetWidth;
      const margin = parseFloat(style.marginLeft) + parseFloat(style.marginRight);
      const fullSlideWidth = slideWidth + margin;
      const prevIndex = (index - 1 + slides.length) % slides.length;
      const nextIndex = (index + 1) % slides.length;

      const trackShift = (containerWidth / 2) - ((index * fullSlideWidth) + (fullSlideWidth / 2));
      
      track.style.transform = `translateX(${trackShift}px)`;

      slides.forEach(function(s, i) {
        s.classList.toggle('active', i === index);
        s.classList.toggle('is-prev', i === prevIndex);
        s.classList.toggle('is-next', i === nextIndex);
      });
      dots.forEach(function(d, i) {
        d.classList.toggle('active', i === index);
      });
    }

    function goTo(i) {
      index = (i + slides.length) % slides.length;
      update();
    }

    function next() {
      goTo(index + 1);
    }

    function prev() {
      goTo(index - 1);
    }

    if (nextBtn) nextBtn.addEventListener('click', next);
    if (prevBtn) prevBtn.addEventListener('click', prev);

    window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
      requestAnimationFrame(update);
    });

    setTimeout(update, 50);

    if (autoplay > 0) {
      const start = function() {
        timer = setInterval(next, autoplay);
      };
      const stop = function() {
        if (timer) clearInterval(timer);
        timer = null;
      };
      carousel.addEventListener('mouseenter', stop);
      carousel.addEventListener('mouseleave', start);
      start();
    }
  }

  function initBannerCarousels() {
    ensureBannerStyle();
    document.querySelectorAll('.banner-carousel').forEach(initCarousel);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initBannerCarousels);
  } else {
    initBannerCarousels();
  }
})();
</script>

Java 开发中的性能优化技巧
在 Java 开发过程中，性能优化是一个永恒的话题。今天我来分享一些实用的性能优化技巧，这些技巧在实际项目中都经过验证。

1. 合理使用集合框架
ArrayList
Post.more:
1. 合理使用集合框架

ArrayList vs LinkedList

// 频繁随机访问时使用 ArrayList
List<String> arrayList = new ArrayList<>();

// 频繁插入删除时使用 LinkedList
List<String> linkedList = new LinkedList<>();

HashMap 初始容量设置

// 避免频繁扩容，预设合理的初始容量
Map<String, Object> map = new HashMap<>(16);

// 如果知道大概数据量，可以这样计算
int expectedSize = 1000;
Map<String, Object> optimizedMap = new HashMap<>(expectedSize / 0.75f + 1);

2. 字符串操作优化

使用 StringBuilder

// 避免这样做
String result = "";
for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {
    result += "item" + i;
}

// 推荐这样做
StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {
    sb.append("item").append(i);
}
String result = sb.toString();

字符串常量池

// 使用字符串常量池
String s1 = "hello";

// 避免不必要的 new String()
String s2 = new String("hello"); // 不推荐

3. 对象创建优化

对象重用

// 重用 SimpleDateFormat
private static final ThreadLocal<SimpleDateFormat> DATE_FORMAT = 
    ThreadLocal.withInitial(() -> new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd"));

public String formatDate(Date date) {
    return DATE_FORMAT.get().format(date);
}

避免在循环中创建对象

// 避免这样做
for (int i = 0; i < 10000; i++) {
    String temp = new String("temp");
    // do something
}

// 推荐这样做
String temp = "temp";
for (int i = 0; i < 10000; i++) {
    // do something with temp
}

4. 数据库操作优化

批量操作

// 使用批量插入
String sql = "INSERT INTO user (name, email) VALUES (?, ?)";
try (PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {
    for (User user : users) {
        ps.setString(1, user.getName());
        ps.setString(2, user.getEmail());
        ps.addBatch();
    }
    ps.executeBatch();
}

连接池配置

# application.yml
spring:
  datasource:
    hikari:
      maximum-pool-size: 20
      minimum-idle: 5
      connection-timeout: 30000
      idle-timeout: 600000
      max-lifetime: 1800000

5. JVM 参数调优

堆内存设置

# 设置堆内存大小
-Xms2g -Xmx2g

# 设置新生代比例
-XX:NewRatio=3

# 启用 G1GC
-XX:+UseG1GC
-XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200

监控和诊断

# 启用 GC 日志
-XX:+PrintGC
-XX:+PrintGCDetails
-XX:+PrintGCTimeStamps

# 开启远程监控
-Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote
-Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.port=9999
-Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.authenticate=false
-Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.ssl=false

6. 缓存策略

本地缓存

@Component
public class CacheService {
    
    private final Cache<String, Object> cache = Caffeine.newBuilder()
            .maximumSize(10000)
            .expireAfterWrite(Duration.ofMinutes(5))
            .build();
    
    public Object get(String key) {
        return cache.getIfPresent(key);
    }
    
    public void put(String key, Object value) {
        cache.put(key, value);
    }
}

Redis 缓存

@Service
public class UserService {
    
    @Cacheable(value = "users", key = "#id")
    public User getUserById(Long id) {
        return userRepository.findById(id);
    }
    
    @CacheEvict(value = "users", key = "#user.id")
    public void updateUser(User user) {
        userRepository.save(user);
    }
}

总结

性能优化是一个持续的过程，需要：

  1. 测量先行: 使用性能分析工具定位瓶颈
  2. 合理优化: 针对真正的性能瓶颈进行优化
  3. 权衡取舍: 在代码可读性和性能之间找到平衡
  4. 持续监控: 在生产环境中持续监控性能指标

记住：”过早的优化是万恶之源”，但合理的优化能显著提升用户体验。
